phase: box 6 smoke — file-memory real-repos harness end-to-end (N=1)
title: fix: #3253 cannot use identifiers containing special characters in function `derivative`
goal: verify mechanism wiring end-to-end on a real repo (not a pilot result; N=1 deltas are not conclusions)
harness_problems_found: First ON run hit the 300s wall timeout and was killed before claude emitted its JSON envelope (cost/tokens came back null). Root cause: timeoutMs (300s) < budget-bounded runtime. Fix: raised timeoutMs to 600s so --max-budget-usd 0.50 is the limiter. Re-run produced a clean envelope.

Killed first-ON run left an inject-context hook handle on .tracebase/memory.db, causing EBUSY on the next workspace cleanup. Fix: junction-aware removeWorkspace() (rmdir the node_modules junction link first, then rmSync with retries). Lock self-released; clone node_modules never damaged.

Recall relevance (observation, not a wiring bug): the locked prompt template prepends the repo README (800 chars); the inject-context FTS query is the full prompt, so recall matched README/docs/package.json rather than derivative.js. file_memory injected real content but not the navigationally-useful files for this task. Pilot at N=25 will measure whether this nets positive.
smoke_verdict: PASS — harness works end-to-end on a real repo: OFF and ON both materialize, run, and verify; file_memory injects/renders; indexer seeds only indexed_files; all metrics captured. N=1 token/duration deltas exceed pilot targets but that is a data point for the pilot, not a smoke gate.
spend_note: Measured clean trajectories: OFF $0.2512 + ON $0.2208 = $0.4720. Plus one aborted ON run with no envelope (bounded < $0.50 by --max-budget-usd). Total session spend < ~$1.0, within the $2.00 cap.
